release_identity.purpose: Create release tags only. This identity has no main-branch bypass.

mitigations: Every other dispatchable workflow rejects the App actor
Production evidence remains content-addressed outside mutable Actions artifacts

lifecycle_identity.purpose: Initiate only the six founder-reviewed lifecycle and Cloud deployment workflows. The App does not authorize a Cloud deploy and has no Cloud repository or deployment permission.

lifecycle_ref_identity.purpose: Create or fast-forward only the protected Production lifecycle feed ref. The inactive identity must fail closed until the founder approves its trust root.

docs_identity.purpose: Dispatch only the founder-reviewed documentation synchronization workflow and create its reviewable pull request. The workflow GITHUB_TOKEN pushes the automation branch.

cloud_checkout_identity.purpose: Issue one short-lived token for the exact openadapt-cloud commit. The token has Contents read only and cannot dispatch, deploy, write source, or bypass a rule.
